spans.text: Hell if I know, fuck, I can't see anything! My eyes—

units.rawText: Before they could finish, the newcomer landed two swift blows to their heads, sending the pair sprawling to the ground, incapacitated.
units.displayText: Before they could finish, the newcomer landed two swift blows to their heads, sending the pair sprawling to the ground, incapacitated.

units.rawText: Bonne... ville...
units.displayText: Bonne... ville...

spans.text: Bonne... ville...

units.rawText: Hey, can you stand?
units.displayText: Hey, can you stand?

spans.text: Hey, can you stand?

units.rawText: I just fell over from being shoved. I'm alright... but you... why are you carrying a baseball bat?
units.displayText: I just fell over from being shoved. I'm alright... but you... why are you carrying a baseball bat?

spans.text: I just fell over from being shoved. I'm alright... but you... why are you carrying a baseball bat?

units.rawText: Don't underestimate a former biker gang member! These two swings are a return gift for what they treated to me earlier. I'm not the type to hold grudges. Usually settle them on the same day.
units.displayText: Don't underestimate a former biker gang member! These two swings are a return gift for what they treated to me earlier. I'm not the type to hold grudges. Usually settle them on the same day.

spans.text: Don't underestimate a former biker gang member! These two swings are a return gift for what they treated to me earlier. I'm not the type to hold grudges. Usually settle them on the same day.

units.rawText: Haha, that's so you. The finals are coming up soon, aren't you worried about the committee penalizing you for this?
units.displayText: Haha, that's so you. The finals are coming up soon, aren't you worried about the committee penalizing you for this?

spans.text: Haha, that's so you. The finals are coming up soon, aren't you worried about the committee penalizing you for this?

units.rawText: Oh, whatever, I've won enough titles. Me, I just get onto the track for the thrill of it all.
units.displayText: Oh, whatever, I've won enough titles. Me, I just get onto the track for the thrill of it all.

spans.text: Oh, whatever, I've won enough titles. Me, I just get onto the track for the thrill of it all.

units.rawText: I don't really care what other people think of me. So long as they lose to me on the track, well, they'd have to at least admit I'm faster than them.
units.displayText: I don't really care what other people think of me. So long as they lose to me on the track, well, they'd have to at least admit I'm faster than them.

spans.text: I don't really care what other people think of me. So long as they lose to me on the track, well, they'd have to at least admit I'm faster than them.

units.rawText: Hey, what's with you? Why the silent treatment?
units.displayText: Hey, what's with you? Why the silent treatment?

spans.text: Hey, what's with you? Why the silent treatment?

units.rawText: <size=28>Yeah... you have enough titles already... No. 42, the great and renowned Bonneville. Three-time champion...</size>
units.displayText: Yeah... you have enough titles already... No. 42, the great and renowned Bonneville. Three-time champion...

spans.text: Yeah... you have enough titles already... No. 42, the great and renowned Bonneville. Three-time champion...

units.rawText: The wind at your side, the sounds of the machine under you, not a worry in the world but the track and your bike. Makes you feel free, no?
units.displayText: The wind at your side, the sounds of the machine under you, not a worry in the world but the track and your bike. Makes you feel free, no?

spans.text: The wind at your side, the sounds of the machine under you, not a worry in the world but the track and your bike. Makes you feel free, no?

units.rawText: <size=28>No... I don't think it's beautiful, in any sense of the word...</size>
units.displayText: No... I don't think it's beautiful, in any sense of the word...

spans.text: No... I don't think it's beautiful, in any sense of the word...

units.rawText: <size=28>How... is it still possible for someone to simply think of racing as amusement? It's so painfully obvious we're just... manipulated mannequins, always accelerating on a set track.</size>
units.displayText: How... is it still possible for someone to simply think of racing as amusement? It's so painfully obvious we're just... manipulated mannequins, always accelerating on a set track.

spans.text: How... is it still possible for someone to simply think of racing as amusement? It's so painfully obvious we're just... manipulated mannequins, always accelerating on a set track.

units.rawText: Freedom, what a thought! The moment we step onto the field of competition, we forfeit it.
units.displayText: Freedom, what a thought! The moment we step onto the field of competition, we forfeit it.

spans.text: Freedom, what a thought! The moment we step onto the field of competition, we forfeit it.

units.rawText: Do you know what you are saying, Thurbel?
units.displayText: Do you know what you are saying, Thurbel?

spans.text: Do you know what you are saying, Thurbel?

units.rawText: The light behind Bonneville illuminates the alley as if it were a sunny midday. She stood there, blocking enough of the light for the blonde in front of her to open her eyes. With a mocking smile and almost absent-minded countenance on Thurbel's face, Bonneville finds an inconceivable chill running through her heart.

units.displayText: Bonneville, you have enough titles already…

units.rawText: So letting me have this one isn't out of the question, surely.
